# Vidhya Sri Ambulance

> Vidhya Sri Ambulance provides 24×7 emergency ambulance, advanced life support (ALS), ICU, neonatal (NICU), and planned patient transportation across Hyderabad, Telangana, and intercity corridors across India.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://vidhyasriambulance.com): Emergency dispatch, service directory, and rapid booking.
- [About](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/about): Mission, paramedic fleet standards, response protocols, and verified credentials.
- [Services](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services): Complete portfolio of medical transport options.
- [Coverage](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/coverage): 14 key dispatch zones across Greater Hyderabad.
- [Contact](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/contact): 24/7 direct helpline, dispatch hub location, and support forms.

## Ambulance Services
- [Emergency Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/emergency-ambulance): Rapid-response emergency ALS ambulance with trained paramedics.
- [ICU Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/icu-ambulance): Mobile intensive care unit with multi-para monitors and critical care equipment.
- [Ventilator Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/ventilator-ambulance): Advanced mechanical ventilator support for respiratory emergencies.
- [BLS Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/bls-ambulance): Basic Life Support transport for stable patients requiring monitoring.
- [Patient Transfer Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/patient-transfer-ambulance): Scheduled inter-hospital transfers and diagnostic visit transit.
- [Oxygen Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/oxygen-ambulance): Continuous flow medical-grade oxygen support transport.
- [NICU Neonatal Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/nicu-neonatal-ambulance): Specialized incubators and pediatric life-support for newborns.
- [Outstation Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/outstation-ambulance): Long-distance intercity transfers from Hyderabad across India.
- [Event Standby Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/event-standby-ambulance): Dedicated on-site medical standby for sports, concerts, and public gatherings.
- [Corporate Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/corporate-ambulance): Emergency response partnerships for tech parks and industrial sites.
- [Mortuary Ambulance](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/mortuary-ambulance): Dignified deceased patient transport with refrigeration.
- [Dead Body Freezer Box](https://vidhyasriambulance.com/services/dead-body-freezer-box): Temperature-controlled preservation units for home and transit.
